name: Nether Earth ZS Edition '99: view
summary: The isometric view: the buffer, the painter's walk over the map, the masked sprites.

entries.name: DrawView
entries.summary: Draw the isometric view: background, objects, copy to the screen

entries.name: DrawMapObjects
entries.summary: Draw the 32 x 16 cells of the view back to front into the view buffer

entries.name: DrawCell
entries.summary: Draw map cell HL (A = its byte) at view row D, column E

entries.name: CheckObjectNeighbour
entries.summary: Ship: an object at HL counts, and so do the blocks around it

entries.name: FindLatestBlock
entries.summary: DE = the cell drawn last among DE and the blocks next to HL

entries.name: CheckBlockNeighbour
entries.summary: A block at HL competes for the latest cell

entries.name: KeepLaterCell
entries.summary: DE = HL if map cell HL is drawn after cell DE

entries.name: FindRobot
entries.summary: Z: IY the robot record standing on map cell HL, B = 48 - its slot (slots 0-23 the player's)

entries.name: FindBuilding
entries.summary: Z: IY the building record (Buildings) on map cell HL

entries.name: DrawCellObject
entries.summary: Draw the object of map cell HL (bit 6): a robot, a building or a shot

entries.name: DrawMover
entries.summary: Draw robot or shot IY found at cell HL (view row D, column E), after the blocks that overlap it

entries.name: DrawMoverSprite
entries.summary: Draw IY: a robot record ($DA00 up) as a stack of parts, a shot as one sprite

entries.name: DrawRobot
entries.summary: Draw robot IY at view row D, column E: its parts bottom up

entries.name: DrawRobotPart
entries.summary: Draw part 8 - B of robot IY facing +$08, then raise the height

entries.name: DrawSprite
entries.summary: Draw sprite A at view row D, column E, height ($CF3F) into the view buffer

entries.name: DrawViewBackground
entries.summary: Clear the view buffer and paint the corners outside the map

entries.name: ClearViewBuffer
entries.summary: Zero the view buffer $5B00-$677F (20 bytes x 160 rows)

entries.name: FillViewCorner
entries.summary: Fill the top left corner of the view buffer: a staircase of 5 bands

entries.name: DrawEdgeStrips
entries.summary: Copy B strips of 8 rows x 2 bytes (pattern HL) into the buffer, each 8 rows down and 2 bytes left

entries.name: CopyViewToScreen
entries.summary: Copy the view buffer to the screen at character row 1, column 1 (20 x 20 characters)
